description:
Configure the 'RadiationPlanningCore' project to enforce strict safety standards by treating specific warnings as errors.

The project is located at `~/eclipse-workspace/RadiationPlanningCore`. If it is not visible in the Project Explorer, import it (File > Import > General > Existing Projects into Workspace).

Your goal is to modify the project's Java Compiler settings to:
1. Enable project-specific settings.
2. Set 'Resource leak' to Error.
3. Set 'Potential null pointer access' to Error.

After applying the settings, rebuild the project to verify that the warnings in 'DosimetryCalculator.java' turn into errors.
